fields.name: name
fields.doc: Server name reported during initialization and discovery.

fields.name: instructions
fields.doc: Optional human-readable instructions for the model.

fields.name: max_message_bytes
fields.doc: Maximum accepted and emitted message size in bytes (minimum 1024).

fields.name: max_nesting_depth
fields.doc: Maximum JSON nesting depth accepted during parsing (1–256).

fields.name: max_json_nodes
fields.doc: Maximum JSON node count accepted during parsing (minimum 1).

fields.name: cache_ttl_ms
fields.doc: Cache TTL in milliseconds for discovery/list responses.

fields.name: structured_content_json
fields.doc: Optional structured JSON content (must be one valid JSON value when set).

fields.name: is_error
fields.doc: Whether this represents an error condition.
